text:
Lena Ortiz: Heads up 30 HelioStat wants a committed go-live Fri 2025-04-04. Procurement says they need: committed pricing tiers, SOC2 attestation + short data flow note, SSO timeline, and VPC peering IPs. Can we triage?

Noah Kim: I can take SSO + perf guidance. We support SAML + OIDC. Ask them for IdP metadata and whether they need SCIM for provisioning. Also: are they doing inference bursts or steady throughput?

Priya Sharma: Legal: SOC2 attestation OK, DPA covers standard egress. Customer-managed KMS will need the KMS addendum signed. I can surface a 1-paragraph attestation and the addendum link. No immediate legal roadblock.

Evan Holt: For peering we need their AWS account IDs and the CIDR ranges. If we get those before EOD we can provision peering in ~48h; otherwise it's 3-5 business days. Also: NAT vs VPC peering preference?

Lena Ortiz: Thanks. Procurement also asked for a sample committed pricing table (they want a discount at 500k and 2M tokens/mo). Noah / Finance can we share a conservative draft?

Noah Kim: Draft pricing snippet (shareable):
```
Tier A: 0 - 500,000 tokens/month -> $0.0035 / 1k tokens
Tier B: 500,001 - 2,000,000 tokens/month -> $0.0026 / 1k tokens (10% commit discount)
Tier C: 2,000,001+ tokens/month -> $0.0019 / 1k tokens (20% commit discount)
Dedicated pool surcharge: +$X/hr (applies for sustained RPS > 100)
```
Noah Kim: Note: finance wants to sign off on the exact discount bands, but this is conservative and safe for procurement to review.

Priya Sharma: Attestation draft coming — short form: "Redwood Inference operates under SOC2 Type II controls; data processed under the agreed contract will remain in the designated cloud regions. Customer-provided KMS keys are supported via our integration; keys are stored and used within an HSM and are not exported." I'll drop the formal text here in ~45m.

Evan Holt: Quick egress/peering blurb (copyable):
```
Redwood Inference will restrict network egress to the customer's specified CIDR ranges via VPC peering or private connect. Data stored for caching/optimizations will reside only in customer-designated regions. We support standard peering and NAT configurations; provide account IDs + CIDRs to initiate.
```

Lena Ortiz: Great. Action list: 1) Priya posts attestation + addendum link; 2) Evan to confirm peering ETA once account IDs arrive; 3) Noah to get finance signoff on the draft tiers; 4) I'll book an exec sync (15-20m) with their CTO + our CRO if items 1+3 are in place by EOD.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "HelioStat exec sync" 20m at 2025-04-03T18:00:00Z (created by Lena Ortiz).

Noah Kim: I'll flag finance now. If finance needs to tweak numbers, will post final table here.

Priya Sharma: Posting attestation and KMS addendum link now.

Evan Holt: Evan here 5 - will standby for account IDs. If they want NAT we need to know about outbound egress analytics; peering is faster.

Lena Ortiz: TY all. I'll follow up with Procurement and ping when the exec bridge is confirmed. :thumbsup:
